title: Editor crashes instantly at window creation on Windows 11 build 26200 (all rendering drivers, 4.6 & 4.7)
body:
## Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f], v4.6.stable.official
- Not a regression between these versions — identical crash in both.

## System information

Windows 11 Pro build 26200 (Insider/Dev channel) - Godot v4.7.stable - AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Adrenalin driver 32.0.31021.5001, 2026-06-28)

## Issue description

The editor/project manager crashes with an access violation (0xc0000005, jump to address 0) immediately at window creation, before the Project Manager UI ever appears. `--headless` works fine (e.g. `--version`, headless exports OK), so the crash is specific to windowed startup.

The crash is identical across **all rendering drivers** (`--rendering-driver vulkan`, `d3d12`, `opengl3`), which suggests the failure is in window creation / early display server path rather than in any specific renderer. With Vulkan, initialization completes successfully (`Vulkan 1.4.349 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT` is printed) and the crash follows immediately after.

Windows Event Log records: exception 0xc0000005, fault offset 0x0, **faulting module: unknown** — i.e. a call/jump into null, consistent with a corrupted vtable/hook rather than a fault inside a named DLL.

Possibly related: #117000 (silent crashes on the same OS build 26200, unresolved, though that report has delayed random crashes while this one is instant).

### Ruled out (crash persists after each of these)

- AMD in-game/performance overlay disabled
- All Vulkan implicit layers disabled (`VK_LOADER_LAYERS_DISABLE='*'`, plus explicit `DISABLE_VK_LAYER_VALVE_steam_fossilize_1`, `DISABLE_VK_LAYER_VALVE_steam_overlay_1`, RTSS) — registered layers on the system were Steam Overlay, Steam Fossilize, RTSS
- `--accessibility disabled`
- `--tablet-driver dummy`
- Windows compatibility layer (`__COMPAT_LAYER=WIN10RTM`)
- `AppInit_DLLs` empty / `LoadAppInit_DLLs=0`
- No RTSS/Afterburner/Nahimic/RGB-suite processes running
- Other Vulkan/D3D12 windowed applications (games, browsers, ComfyUI) work normally on the same machine

### Backtrace (identical every run, console build, `--verbose`)

```
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.stable.official (5b4e0cb0fd279832bbdd69fed5354d4e5ad26f88)
[1] 7ff75a1160e1 (main+40c60e1)
[2] 7ff98829f932 (ntdll.dll+11f932)
[3] 7ff9882e47ae (ntdll.dll+1647ae)
[4] 7ff9881a21c6 (ntdll.dll+221c6)
[5] 7ff9882e40ed (ntdll.dll+1640ed)
[6] -1 (main+-7ff756050001)
```

Last verbose lines before the crash (vulkan): device selection completes, shader caches load, then crash. On the default/opengl3 path the log additionally shows `WARNING: ... switching to ANGLE` → `ERROR: Can't initialize an EGL display` → `Failed to create ANGLE OpenGL window` before the same crash.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Windows 11 Insider build 26200, AMD RX 9070 XT
2. Launch the official Godot 4.6/4.7 Windows build (any rendering driver)
3. Crash before the Project Manager window appears

No project needed (crashes in Project Manager).

## Minimal reproduction project

N/A — crashes in Project Manager before any project is opened.
